thread:
support-bot: ALERT: customer=acme-app prod-us-east p99 latency spike detected (baseline 210ms -> 1.9s) :bangbang:
monica: seeing it on dashboards, p95 up too, started ~08:12 UTC :eyes:
jamal: any recent rollouts in that region?
deploy-bot: rolled out config: streaming-batcher v3.4.1 -> v3.5.0 to prod-us-east at 08:05 UTC (batcher params changed)
nora: which params changed? I saw a PR about adaptive coalescing.
kevin: PR notes: introduced `coalesce_delay_ms=8` (was 20), `min_batch=1` (was 4), and `adaptive_backoff=true` — aimed at reducing median latency.
eli: lowering coalesce_delay and min_batch sounds like it could increase tiny-batch churn and tail. p99 on small prompts will blow up.
monica: can we repro quickly on a canary node? I can spin a traffic generator for small prompts.
jamal: repro step I used earlier: run 500 qps of 16-token prompts to a single inference pod. Locally I see many single-request batches and KV thrash.
monica: reproducer run (short):
```
# generate 500 qps small prompts for 60s
wrk -t4 -c200 -d60s --timeout 2000s \ 
  "http://pod-ip:8080/v1/generate" -s small_prompt.lua
```
monica: logs show frequent `batch_size=1` and `batch_hold_ms` hitting the new low threshold; this correlates with high scheduler overhead and GC.
nora: quick mitigation idea: revert `min_batch` to 4 or increase `coalesce_delay_ms` back to 20 to encourage aggregation. Any downside? throughput cost maybe, cost per-token up.
jamal: agree +1 to revert to safe defaults while we iterate.
kevin: I can hotpatch config in prod-us-east now via config service: `redwood cfg set batcher.coalesce_delay_ms=20 --region prod-us-east` and `redwood cfg set batcher.min_batch=4 --region prod-us-east`. Expect ~2-3 min to roll.
eli: if we revert, also disable `adaptive_backoff` in that rollout to avoid oscillation.
monica: after hotpatch, watching p95/p99...
[~2 minutes pass]
monica: p99 dropped from 1.9s -> 320ms, p95 back to ~180ms. Nice. :tada:
support-bot: NOTIFICATION: latency alert resolved for acme-app prod-us-east.
jamal: postmortem action items in backlog: investigate why adaptive_backoff triggered too aggressively for small-payload workloads; add canary test for small prompt qps before full rollout.
nora: also add a guard: do not set `min_batch` < 2 for production without manual review.
kevin: I'll open the rollback PR + followup tests. Assigning to me and jamal.
monica: docs note: tradeoff is median vs tail. Lowering coalesce delay reduced median but created pathological tiny-batch tail for bursty small prompts. We'll add a short runbook for on-call to revert these three params.
eli: FYI, customer support already messaged acme-app with brief status note.
monica: marking this thread resolved, will link postmortem when written. :white_check_mark:
